title: TigerStone1263 — Apps that train your musical ear
description: TigerStone1263 makes the ear-training apps Pitch Academy and Absolute Ear.
tagline: We make apps that train your musical ear

scene2_d: From reading the staff to tapping along in rhythm

pa_line: Ear training to sight-singing, all in one app
